attr.title: Stardew Valley — RG34XXSP (KNULLI)
attr.desc: Experimental Windows/Linux mainline port for Anbernic RG34XXSP on KNULLI, with built-in motor rumble and optional SMAPI.
attr.inst: Copy a clean Windows or Linux Steam mainline installation into stardewvalleymainline/gamedata. Requires 64-bit KNULLI and PortMaster. Retail gameplay and hardware validation pending. See README.md.
